fields.climate: tropical marine; northeast monsoon (November to April); southwest monsoon (May to October)
fields.terrain: mostly mountains with narrow to extensive coastal lowlands
fields.hazards: astride typhoon belt, usually affected by several cyclonic storms each year; landslides; active volcanoes; destructive earthquakes; tsunamis; volcanism: significant volcanic activity…
fields.resources: timber, petroleum, nickel, cobalt, silver, gold, salt, copper
fields.farm: sugarcane, rice, coconuts, maize, bananas, vegetables, tropical fruits, plantains, pineapples, cassava
fields.exports: integrated circuits, machine parts, gold, insulated wire, semiconductors
fields.industries: semiconductors and electronics assembly, business process outsourcing, food and beverage manufacturing, construction, electric/gas/water supply, chemical products, radio/television/communications…
fields.languages: Tagalog 39.9%, Bisaya/Binisaya 16%, Hiligaynon/Ilonggo 7.3%, Ilocano 7.1%, Cebuano 6.5%, Bikol/Bicol 3.9%, Waray 2.6%, Kapampangan 2.4%, Maguindanao 1.4%, Pangasinan/Panggalato 1.3%, other…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 78.8%, Muslim 6.4%, Iglesia ni Cristo 2.6%, other Christian 3.9%, other 8.2%, none/unspecified <0.1
fields.legal: mixed system of civil, common, Islamic (sharia), and customary law
fields.military: some variations in age based on the branch of service, but generally 18-27 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
